meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需编排镜头与动态元素,产出多场景视频、品牌宣传片或混剪成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做较长的多场景视频或宣传片,却没有现成的专用流程可用
copy.tagline_en: Compose scenes and motion to produce multi-scene videos, brand reels, or remixes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a longer multi-scene video but no specialized workflow fits

howto.what: 它接管自定义视频的制作与剪辑:先读或写 BRIEF.md,规划分镜(STORYBOARD.md),逐场景编排画面、动效、音频与字幕,再走校验与渲染审批。适用多场景长片、品牌片、蒙太奇、静态循环与素材混剪等。
howto.when: 当没有更专用的工作流适配时接管,或 BRIEF.md 中 flow 设为 companion 时接管;新建项目需先经过 /hyperframes 路由,再回到本技能。

say.text: 帮我做一支多场景的品牌宣传片,先出分镜给我看
把这段素材剪成蒙太奇,保留原声
say.note: 按片段范围与顺序重新编排剪辑

say.text: 用 companion 流程和我一起搭这支片子
say.note: 以协作方式共同打磨方案

howto.what_en: It authors or edits custom videos: read or write BRIEF.md, plan a storyboard (STORYBOARD.md), build each scene's visuals, motion, audio and captions, then validate and approve the render. Suits multi-scene pieces, montages and remixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion; fresh creation must route through /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Make a multi-scene brand reel and show me the storyboard first
say_en.note: Reads or writes BRIEF.md, then plans STORYBOARD.md

say_en.text: Cut this footage into a montage and keep the original audio
say_en.note: Copies clips with source ranges and placement

say_en.text: Build this piece with me using the companion flow
